source: Native Icon Composer document Design/AppIcon/Lineup.icon, redrawn by hand from the approved raycast-v2-muted Zones artwork.
status: Henrique approved the restrained raycast-v2-muted style and asked for an app icon on Apple's native macOS workflow. The three-pane symbol is unchanged; no image generation was used.

currentSelection.decision: Keep the three-pane symbol; move the app icon to a native Icon Composer document
schemaSources: Installed Xcode macOS Icon Composer template (Icon Composer Icon.xctemplate/icon.json)
Apple Landmarks sample app icon (Landmarks App Icon.icon/icon.json)
currentSelection.geometry: Measured on the 1254 px reference: three panes centered on the canvas, group 716 x 673 px, pane corner radius 46 px, gaps 42-47 px. Scaled by 1024/1254 and squared up to equal columns, equal rows and one 36 px gap: left pane 220,237 274 x 550; right panes 530,237 and 530,530, each 274 x 257; radius 38. Pane color #F2F5FA sampled from the reference.
currentSelection.background: Vertical linear-gradient from #3F7EED to #2F69DF, the reference's average top and bottom rows. The diagonal tilt of the generated raster is not reproduced.
currentSelection.material: Layer glass false. Group shadow kind none, specular false, translucency disabled. With glass off, ictool renders identical pixels for shadow none and neutral and for specular on and off; the system shape edge highlight remains.
currentSelection.generation: No image generation. ictool renders previews; actool compiles the bundle resources. Tool versions and arguments are in receipt.json.
currentSelection.menuBar: Existing three-pane monochrome template in Sources/lineup/App/Brand.swift, unchanged
exports: Assets.car (compiled at bundle time by Scripts/build-app.sh)

history.decision: Refined enamel Zones raster with a subtler background gradient

history.generation: No new generation; deterministic export from the existing master
